aspect: The recurring cost against a low income
description: Products are bought monthly for roughly forty years, in a household where the purchase competes with food.
energy_note: A monthly purchase that competes with dinner.

aspect: School days lost where facilities are absent
description: Where a school has no water, no door on the latrine and no disposal, attendance during menstruation becomes impractical - a recurring absence that compounds into the attainment gap in EDU-002.
energy_note: A week a month, missed, for want of a door.

description: Cloth, tissue and rags used repeatedly without adequate washing water produce urinary and reproductive tract infections, which then need the health system in HLT-001.
energy_note: An infection produced by the lack of a product.

description: The school latrine has no door and no water. She works out, at twelve, that missing four days a month is more tolerable than the alternative. By JSS3 she is a term behind in mathematics and is described by her teacher as not strong at it.
energy_note: A term behind, and it is recorded as aptitude.
